capabilities.name: A law that covers AI agents is in force
capabilities.question: Is there a law in force in this country that applies to AI systems acting for users?

US.note: There is no federal AI law. Texas's Responsible AI Governance Act has applied since 1 January 2026, and other states have their own AI rules. Executive Order 14365 (December 2025) tells federal agencies to challenge state AI laws. These are binding AI rules, but they cover specific harms and uses, not agents acting for you, so the cell is limited.

evidence.title: HB 149, Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act (bill history)
Executive Order 14365: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence

GB.note: The UK has no AI law and no binding AI-specific rules, so the cell is none. Regulators apply general laws, such as the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 on automated decisions. In September 2026 Parliament's Joint Committee on Human Rights asked the government for a dedicated AI Bill; we found no government bill yet.

evidence.title: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025
Human Rights and the Regulation of AI (Fourth Report of Session 2026-27)
evidence.publisher: Joint Committee on Human Rights, UK Parliament

DE.note: The EU AI Act is in force in Germany, so the cell is live. Its transparency duties for AI systems apply since 2 August 2026. The Digital Omnibus (Regulation 2026/1744, in force 27 July 2026) delays the high-risk rules to December 2027 and August 2028, gives systems already on the market until 2 December 2026 to mark AI-generated content, and adds a new ban on AI built to make non-consensual intimate images or child sexual abuse material. The Act does not name shopping agents, but it covers AI systems that act for users.

evidence.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
AI Act: regulatory framework
EU Digital Omnibus on AI enters into force

IN.note: India has no AI law, and officials say none is planned; the India AI Governance Guidelines (November 2025) are voluntary. But binding IT Rules changes in force since 20 February 2026 make platforms label AI-made audio, images and video. Like the US rules, they cover specific harms, not agents acting for you, so the cell is limited.

evidence.title: MeitY unveils India AI Governance Guidelines
evidence.publisher: PIB, Ministry of Electronics and IT

evidence.title: India AI Governance Guidelines: Enabling Safe and Trusted AI Innovation
Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules, 2026 (G.S.R. 120(E))

BR.note: The Senate passed the AI framework bill (PL 2338/2023) in December 2024. In October 2026 it was still in a special committee of the Chamber of Deputies, waiting for the rapporteur's report, so it is not law. It passed one chamber, so the cell is announced. General laws such as the data protection law (LGPD) still apply.

evidence.title: Marco da Inteligência Artificial é aprovado em Plenário e vai à Câmara
PL 2338/2023 (ficha de tramitação)

MX.note: Mexico has no AI law and no binding AI rules. In October 2026 the Chamber of Deputies published a proposal to give Congress the power to legislate on AI, and we found no AI bill that has passed either chamber. As in Colombia, only lawmakers' proposals are pending, so the cell is none.

evidence.title: Gaceta Parlamentaria, 7 October 2026 (constitutional reform proposal on AI)

CL.note: The AI bill (boletín 16821-19) passed the Chamber of Deputies in October 2025 and is in its second step in the Senate. It sorts AI systems by risk and gives oversight to the data protection agency. It passed one chamber but is not law yet, so the cell is announced.

evidence.title: Proyecto de ley que regula los sistemas de inteligencia artificial (boletín 16821-19)
Ley de Inteligencia Artificial: últimas novedades en su tramitación

CO.note: Colombia has no AI law. The government's AI bill (043/2025 Senado, 324/2025 Cámara) was archived because it got no first vote within the session. Lawmakers filed a new AI bill (025/2026 Cámara) in July 2026, and it waits in committee. As in Mexico, only lawmakers' bills are pending, so the cell is none.

evidence.title: Colombia elige una inteligencia artificial centrada en la vida, los derechos y el interés público con radicación del proyecto de ley de IA
Proyecto de Ley 043/2025 Senado, 324/2025 Cámara (inteligencia artificial)
Gaceta del Congreso 878 de 2026 (Proyecto de Ley 025 de 2026 Cámara)

capabilities.name: You can get your money back when an agent buys the wrong thing
capabilities.question: Do consumer or payment rules, or a regulator statement, clearly cover purchases or payments an AI agent made for you?

US.note: US rules refund unauthorized card and bank-account payments and billing errors, and card networks handle disputes, but they were written for human buyers. Authorization is defined as the consumer's permission, so an agent's mistake is a gray area. In April 2026 American Express announced protection for purchases made by registered agents, as a company product, not a rule.

evidence.title: Electronic Fund Transfers, Regulation E, section 1005.6 (liability of consumer)
American Express Debuts Agentic Commerce Experiences (ACE) Developer Kit and Announces Industry-First Protection for Registered Agent Purchases

GB.note: The Payment Services Regulations 2017 oblige banks to refund unauthorized payments, and section 75 of the Consumer Credit Act makes card lenders liable for faulty goods. Neither says what happens when software buys for you. HM Treasury's July 2026 consultation asks whether consent and liability rules for agent payments need changing; its answer is still open.

evidence.title: Payment Services Regulations 2017, regulation 76 (refunds for unauthorised payments)
Consumer Credit Act 1974, section 75
Modernising Payment Services Regulation (consultation)

DE.note: German law (BGB section 675u) makes the bank refund payments you did not authorize, and section 355 gives a 14-day right to withdraw from online purchases, whoever placed the order. Neither rule mentions agents. The EU's new payment rules (PSD3 and the Payment Services Regulation), agreed in November 2025 and not yet applying, add stronger fraud refunds, but the Council's summary of the deal does not mention agents either.

evidence.title: BGB § 675u (Haftung des Zahlungsdienstleisters für nicht autorisierte Zahlungsvorgänge)
BGB § 355 (Widerrufsrecht bei Verbraucherverträgen)
Payment services: Council and Parliament agree to step up the fight against fraud and increase transparency

IN.note: The Reserve Bank of India's 2017 circular limits your loss on unauthorized electronic payments and orders banks to credit the money within 10 working days. The E-Commerce Rules 2020 require platforms to answer complaints within a month. Neither names agents, and an order an agent places for you may count as authorized.

evidence.title: Customer Protection: Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions
Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020

BR.note: Brazil's consumer code gives seven days to withdraw from a distance purchase, and the central bank's Pix refund scheme (MED) returns money after fraud or a bank error. The central bank says MED does not cover a purchase that went wrong, such as the wrong item, and no rule names agents.

evidence.title: Guia de implementação dos procedimentos de devolução no Pix (MED)
Lei 8.078/1990, Código de Defesa do Consumidor

MX.note: Condusef, the national commission that protects users of financial services, says a bank must credit a charge you do not recognize within about 48 hours while it investigates for up to 45 days, and for online buys the bank must prove it used online authentication. The consumer protection law (LFPC) covers online sales. None of it names agents, and an agent's order is one you asked for.

evidence.title: Cargos no reconocidos
Garantía y compras en línea

CL.note: Chile's consumer law (Ley 19.496), which SERNAC enforces, gives a right to withdraw from purchases made online, and Ley 20.009 makes the card issuer refund charges you say you did not authorize. Neither names agents, and an order an agent places for you may count as authorized.

evidence.title: Ley 19.496, normas sobre protección de los derechos de los consumidores
Ley 20.009, limita la responsabilidad de los usuarios de tarjetas de pago y transacciones electrónicas

CO.note: Article 51 of Colombia's consumer statute (Ley 1480) lets you ask for a payment reversal on online purchases that were fraudulent, not requested by you, not delivered or not as ordered, if you complain within five business days. It is the closest rule to this question anywhere in the eight countries, but it does not name agents.

evidence.title: Ley 1480 de 2011, Estatuto del Consumidor, artículo 51 (reversión del pago)
